name: Bausch Health (BHC)
teaser: Bausch Health parent cash is a 54.5% yield on the market value in 2026, but falls to about 2% by 2030 after interest and the Xifaxan cliff. Watchlist, no new buy: the required 70% margin of safety exceeds the framework ceiling, so no buy price is issued.
llms: Leveraged specialty pharmaceutical and aesthetic devices company (Salix with Xifaxan, International, Diversified, Solta) that controls the listed eye-care company Bausch + Lomb, with about 15.1 billion dollars of parent debt. Valued as a sum of the parts: parent EV to EBITDA after stock compensation plus the Bausch + Lomb stake, cross-checked with a patent cliff free cash flow model. Parent cash is about 1.3 billion dollars in 2026, a 54.5% yield on the market value, but falls to about 50 million dollars by 2030 after interest on the Base case. Bear $0.00 (equity wiped out), Base $9.57, Bull $29.23. Verdict WATCHLIST, NO NEW BUY at $6.04; no maximum buy price issued because the required margin of safety of 70% exceeds the framework ceiling.
